text: Back to Ships or Galleons Sails in ArcheAge are the sole avenue for propulsion on most boats, (save fishing boats and speedboats) whilst some boats can be equipped with only one type of sail, Galleons, in particular, can be equipped with a variety of sails that have different pros and cons, we will explore these aforementioned sails in this wiki page. Starting with the most widely used sail on the majority of boats, The Caernord Zephyr Triangular Rig. This sail is the only equipable sail on the Adventurer's Clipper, Harpoon Clipper and Merchant Schooner. It does not have any additional tiers and can only be regraded, regrading gives the sail additional health and ship max movement speed. The changes to the sail are listed by tier below. Caernord Zephyr Triangular Rig Grade Equip Effect Health Repair Cost Grand Increases the ship's max Move Speed +42% 15,750 1 Shatigon's Sand Rare Increases the ship's max Move Speed +44% 16,500 1 Shatigon's Sand Arcane Increases the ship's max Move Speed +46% 17,250 1 Shatigon's Sand Heroic Increases the ship's max Move Speed +48% 18,000 1 Shatigon's Sand Unique Increases the ship's max Move Speed +50% 18,750 1 Shatigon's Sand Celestial Increases the ship's max Move Speed +54% 20,250 1 Shatigon's Sand Divine Increases the ship's max Move Speed +60% 22,500 1 Shatigon's Sand Epic Increases the ship's max Move Speed +66% 24,750 2 Shatigon's Sand Legendary Increases the ship's max Move Speed +72% 27,000 3 Shatigon's Sand Mythic Increases the ship's max Move Speed +80% 30,000 4 Shatigon's Sand The weight of the sail is consistent at 1,500kg among all regrade tiers. Moving on from sails that are regular boats, we arrive at sails that can be equipped exclusively on small warships (Eznan Cutter, Lutesong Junk, and the Growling Yawl (Black Pearl)) Beginning with the Lutesong Junk's default sail, The Lutesong Zephyr Square Mainsail and Foresail. This sails primary attribute that sets it apart from other sails is its increase to ship handling, boasting higher turning speed, acceleration and reverse speed than any other sail. Regrading this sail gives bonuses to its Turning Speed, Health, Acceleration, Reverse Speed, Movement Speed and Collision Damage, these increases are listed below side by side with Mainsail on the left and Foresail on the right. This goal of this sail is to have a boat that is highly maneuverable at low speeds, HP wise, this sail type comes in the middle between Growling Zephyr and Eznan Zephyr. The other reason to select anything other than 2 Foresails is the functionality of the Forewind buff, If you use 2 Foresails, you will not get 2 instances of the Forewind buff, alternatively, you can equip your Mainsail in the front slot and your Foresail in the rear slot, this allows the larger hitbox of the Mainsail to block some incoming shots as well as clear a bit of headroom for any crew on the cannons.

These are by far the most common sail seen in the wild, and with good reason, for 99% of galleon uses these sails can and should be your choice.
